services.title: Central Heating Systems

services.title: Tiling and Wall Work

services.title: Pipe and Leak Repairs

about_pullquote: We treat every customer's home like it's our own—honest pricing, skilled work, and no cowboys.
about_para_1: Masterclass Tiling and Plumbing has served Middlesbrough, Thornaby, and surrounding areas for over 15 years. We started because we saw too many householders overcharged and ripped off by traders who took shortcuts. Our founder made a promise: offer the same care and standards he'd expect for his own family. Today, that's still what drives us.
about_para_2: We're Gas Safe registered and fully insured. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned renovation, customers return to us because we answer the phone, arrive on time, and charge what we quote—no surprises. We've built our reputation on reliability, fair pricing, and workmanship that stands the test of time.
